changelog.title: 🛡️ Two-Way Merge Cloud Sync & Offline Outbox Protection
changes: Implemented two-way intelligent merge between local and cloud items to prevent data loss
Added offline pending deletion queue preventing deleted items from resurrecting on sync
Added two-way folder synchronization preserving locally created categories
Automatic cloud upload for unsynced local credentials upon reconnecting

changelog.title: ⚡ Instant Decryption, Keyboard Avoidance & Tailwind Refactor
changes: Instant vault unlock with background cloud sync (<0.5s local access)
KeyboardAvoidingView on credential, folder, and avatar modal inputs
Modular Tailwind / NativeWind FormControls & HubScreen componentization
Automatic check for updates upon internet connectivity

changelog.title: ⚡ VaultAuth Loading States & Android Navigation Bar Clearance
changes: Added animated loading indicators and disabled states to Vault Setup & Complete button
Elevated bottom tab bar and increased padding for Android 3-button navigation bars
Enhanced profile scroll padding to ensure clean footer separation

changelog.title: 🛡️ Custom Alerts, Backup Key Sharing & Navigation Fixes
changes: Replaced all OS system dialogs with sleek in-app theme-matched custom modals
Fixed Download Backup Key to reliably share and save 12-word recovery key across mobile and web
Fixed bottom tab navigation bar clipping and list insets on Android devices
Fixed backend application version endpoint detection for live updates

changelog.title: 👁️ Password Visibility Toggles & Sensitive Field Controls
changes: Added eye visibility toggle buttons to master password fields in unlock and onboarding screens
Added visibility toggle buttons to login passwords, card CVV, card PIN, and API secrets
Added show/mask toggles for sensitive credential fields across inspector and card modals

changelog.title: ✨ Monochrome iOS Theme, Recovery Crash Fix & UI Polish
changes: Fixed recovery key generator crash on native Android (PRNG polyfill)
Switched Password Manager & Vault to clean iOS Black & White monochrome theme
Fixed Android status bar header overlap across vault and unlock screens
Fixed profile screen bottom padding to prevent button cut-off
